page.description: For comics: the work.sequential.page or work.sequential.slice of the chapter the comment is about. Replies keep their parent's value.

panel.description: For comics: index into the panels of the page or strip the comment is about. Replies keep their parent's value.

parent.description: AT URI of the parent comment record. Used for single-level threading.

content.description: The text content of the comment.

subject.description: AT URI of the record being commented on: a site.mochott.article, or a work.sequential.chapter or work.sequential.strip.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the comment was created.

main.description: Record representing a comment on an article or comic. Deleting this record removes the comment.

description: A comment on an article or a comic chapter or strip. Supports single-level threading via the optional parent field.
